payload.title: cms.siteOrigin + prospectusAccountsApiStageArn via app-shell change set
payload.description: Papyrus cms.siteOrigin (generic, for edge-fronted sites). Set siteOrigin and prospectusAccountsApiStageArn in infra/site.json, then deploy the app shell with a reviewed change set. Verify that sign-in returns 303 with redirect_uri on https://shipped.anth.us.
